job.value: set a per-click bid level and weekly budget for Spotlight, then start it

arrivedFrom.value: Spotlight from the listing's seller tools

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The listing 'IKEA MALM 6-drawer dresser' under 'Spotlight' with 'Set goal' and 'Weekly budget' says what this is for.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The teal 'Start Spotlight' button in the bottom bar is the strongest element.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Set goal' is actually a per-click bid stepper ('40 /click'), which the label doesn't predict; 'Change' beside 'Runs weekly until you stop' is clear.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Save / Compete / Dominate' are explained by sub-lines like 'Top 2, outpace rivals', but '40 /click' is never explained as a maximum bid.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Picking a coin amount per click is a bidding decision, softened by the three named tiers and '~38 clicks per week'.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Duration is tucked behind 'Change' and budget is preset chips with a 'Custom' escape.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Everything serves setting up this one listing's Spotlight.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Values and short tier captions carry it; 'You only pay when a buyer clicks.' is one line.
